# Tina Fransgård

Tina Fransgård is a member of the steering committee of [[danibd|DANIBD]] (Denmark's National Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease), serving as a department physician and Ph.D. holder based in Region Sjælland[^src1]. She represents one of Denmark's five regions on the governing body that oversees the collection and validation of clinical data on inflammatory bowel disease patients treated across the country's public hospitals.

DANIBD maintains comprehensive data on patients with inflammatory bowel disease—including Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, short bowel syndrome, and primary sclerosing cholangitis—who have received care at Danish public hospitals[^src1]. The database achieves a data coverage rate exceeding 90 percent based on validation against regional comparative databases[^src1]. Fransgård's role on the steering committee places her among representatives from all five Danish regions, patient advocates, and data administrators from SundK (the national health data authority) who collectively oversee the database's operation and quality assurance[^src1].
